notes.title: V1.1 New Employee Arrival | Endless Mode Launched
notes.content:
[h1]update：[/h1]
[h2]1.Welcome two new employees to the pawn shop！[/h2]
[list]
[*] [h2]Minimalist Experimenter[/h2]
[/list]
With the screwdriver raised and lowered, the troublesome negative labels were accurately cut.
Cruella was determined to cut off all relations with "negative" things, but after coming to the pawn shop, everything didn't seem that easy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990588/4bd676fcfd0f76fe59dc401913c9b0d5a3df35bc.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [h2]Academic Sales[/h2]
[/list]
Take a look, take a look, here are all the best products from White Star!
Cindy is shouting loudly at the door of the pawn shop. The school emblem of a prestigious university is shining on her suit. You are a little suspicious, but all your worries are dispelled when more and more customers enter the store...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990588/e746dab270a4b698da3a2349515ed858dc840b2a.png[/img]
[h2]2.[Endless Mode] is now online[/h2]
[list]
[*] More time：60 days are still unfinished? Don't worry, we've extended your White Star visa to 999 days!
[*] More challenging random BUFF：danger and opportunity coexist, we still don't know what "that woman" will bring next time...
[/list]
[b][h1]repair：[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the [Thank you for playing my game] achievement was not successfully triggered.
[*] Fixed an error where after submitting a task item, there are still customers who want to trade the item
[/list]
[b][h1]Optimize：[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the explosion probability of  Boom Boom Shake
[*] Magician no longer add negative tags when she succeed
[*] Reduced employee base wages
[/list]

notes.title: Roadmap Announced丨Fix Update丨Beta Version
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990588/a1ec73d9c9c5529691c571f5b714947579dbb0ab.png[/img]
1. Repair
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause the employee skill settlement screen in the old save to be displayed in the new game
[*] Fixed the problem of animation flashing white in the prop illustration
[*] Fixed a bug that caused Skylar's skill to remove negative tags to sometimes fail
[*] Fixed the issue where Ms.14 would always add multiple negative labels to the product after her magic failed.
[*] Fixed the issue where the animation would get stuck when Sola changes.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the game process to get stuck during the tutorial.
[*] Fixed the problem of incorrectly unlocking the system when reading old archives (this fix may cause errors in old archives, please open a new archive to play)
[*] Fixed an issue where the achievement was incorrectly unlocked after completing one of the main storyline endings.
[*] Fixed the issue where some achievements (orders, reputation) could not be unlocked
[*] Fixed the error where the skill [Earn $2000 every 10 days] was added as [Debt Repayment Challenge]
[/list]

2. Optimization
[list]
[*] Adjusted the success ratio in tax events and modified the description of the corresponding options
[*] Increased the  reward after successful Kirk identification
[*] The initial number of effort stars increased from [0] to [100]
[*] Added [Skip plot] option
[*] Added guidance for [Cannot start a new game when the archive is full]
[*] Optimized the problem that the sound effects of price changes will be superimposed when using the scroll wheel and mouse.
[*] Optimized text playback speed during conversations
[/list]

3. Update
[list]
[*] Added [Doctor KK] events and subsequent orders
[*] The beta version is open. You can experience the 120 days of opening a store. However, there are currently few new contents. We will continue to develop and add them in the future. If you are interested: Settings-Properties-Input [lowerhighertest]-Select beta-test to play the beta version.Currently only supports Chinese and English，thank you for your support!
[/list]

4. The production team wants to say：
[list]
[*] [b]After the update, the old save cannot be inherited. To avoid errors, please restart the game.[/b]
[*]  If you feel that the sound effect makes you uncomfortable, you can lower the volume of the sound effect in the settings. We will optimize it in the future. Thank you for your tolerance.
[*] We have noticed that there may be a delay in unlocking new achievements, please wait a moment or contact us
[*] We are sorry for the translation quality and will try our best to gradually optimize it starting from English. Thank you for your support
[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.2 update
notes.content:
fixed:
1. Fixed the problem of incorrect consumption of effort stars
2. Fixed the problem that the talent [Add 50 reputation at the beginning] will be triggered repeatedly
3. Fixed the incorrect display of font discoloration in multiple languages
4. Fixed the problem that after selecting a specific talent, upgrading the accountant's skills would cause the game process to freeze.


optimization:
1.Support Spanish
2. Optimized currency change display
3. Optimized bid display animation


Issues to note:
1. The DEMO version may cause a black screen when the official version inherits the save. If the save is inaccessible, please delete the save and try again.

2. The current limit of saves is 3. If you fail or pass the level, the save will be retained. When all 3 save files exist, the New Game button will be hidden. If you need to restart a new game, please delete a  file first.

notes.title: See you on Nov.12th! 20% off for first launch, see details for more game content
notes.content:
Hello, store managers! 
After intensive development, we can finally announce this news to you:

[b]<Lower?Higher!> The official version will be released on November 12, 2024![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44990588/e12020cbc055ebb50a64ae585d7562c6a1b6cc14.png[/img]
————————————————
In the official version, as the new store manager, you will face more challenges:
Nearly 60 characters and hundreds of props! The illustration system is open, get them all!
Nearly 50 events have hit, they are closely related to your store manager life, please don’t take it lightly...
Two months of the main plot is online, and the dual endings have begun. Which path will you choose?
The signal of the delivery system has been strengthened! More than 20 orders have been covered by all White Star!
Graphics updates, animation optimization and a newly upgraded operating system! 
Leave a trophy for your store manager career: Achievements are newly launched!
as well as,
More fun ways to play! 
The sponsorship system, more products and customers, events, etc. are being developed...

Finally, thank you again for your support! If you like it, you can recommend it to your friends

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2913660/_/

notes.title: Lower？Higher!  Demo Optimization!Free launch on Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Dear Bosses, We would like to share that we will participate in the Steam Next Fest(14 Oct - 21 Oct,)!
At that time, the boss position will be open to all White Star people. Welcome to enjoy your rich life!
In the optimized and upgraded demo, you will experience:
There are all kinds of customers, try to bargain based on their characteristics.
Resolve emergencies as a boss.
Train and dispatch employees to make your pawn shop bigger and stronger.
Order system allows you to easily make extra money.
If Lower?Higher! has grabbed your interest, please consider adding it to your Steam wishlist,which would be greatly helpful to us! Thank you!
If you have any feedback, suggestions or any issues, we'd love to hear about it. Your positive feedback is a tremendous encouragement and motivates us to continually improve. 
Thank you for your support!
